generated_content.scenario:
A national government agency in India is developing an enterprise-level information system to manage and disseminate comprehensive data about Indian states and union territories. This system is intended to serve as a central repository for both governmental and public use. It will store detailed information about each state, including political, ecological, cultural, and administrative data.

The system is designed to support various government departments, educational institutions, and researchers by providing access to up-to-date information about state capitals, official symbols (bird, animal, tree, flower), chief ministers, governors, and more. Additionally, the platform will include historical data on past governors and chief ministers, allowing users to track political changes over time.

The platform will need to handle complex queries and offer advanced search capabilities to support detailed analytics and reporting features. It will also include user management to control access based on roles, allowing for a range of users from government officials to academics and the general public. Furthermore, the system should support multilingual access and provide tools for visualizing data such as state maps and charts.
